column1: # dstack Korean scope table (R93). Columns: pattern<TAB>scope
# pattern is a glob on the repository-relative path; the FIRST matching row wins, so put the
# narrow rows above the wide ones. "**/" also matches zero directories, so docs/**/*.md covers
# scope: ko-haeyo | ko-plain (follow the repository's own tone) | ko-data (product copy, i18n,
#        built-in examples: tone rules are skipped) | en | exempt
# A path no row matches is passed and counted as unclassified by `dstack lint-ko --report`, so a
# repository that never declares a scope table is never blocked (R93).
